_comment: THIS TREE'S OWN IDENTITY — the FROM side of every rebrand. tooling/rebrand/rebrand.mjs reads it to know what to rename AWAY from; a product's identity is the --values file, which is the TO side. Change a value here only together with the tree: these strings must be what the tree actually contains, or the rename silently misses and the product ships carrying this baseline's name. `productName` is the SITE_NAME seam in apps/web/lib/site.ts and apps/preview/lib/site.ts; `slug` also names both Workers (<slug>-web, <slug>-preview) and the secret project; `domain` and `subdomain` are placeholders, because this baseline has never deployed under a name of its own; `githubOwner` is the owner in the repository's own links.
